text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 4, "unit": "rows", "kind": "count", "span": "4 rows of seats"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 18, "unit": "seats", "kind": "count", "span": "18 seats in each row"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 1, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "One-third of the remaining seats"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 0.3333333333333333, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "One-third of the remaining seats"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "all the seats: 4 rows of 18"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "one fourth of four equal rows is exactly one row, so the administrators took 18 seats and this many remain"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q3", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "the parents took one third of the rest, so the students got the other two thirds"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "two thirds of the remaining seats"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many students were in the auditorium"}, "dismissed": []}
